introduction: Move every model-facing prompt, system mandate, tool description override, guard refusal and handler rejection from Go string constants and fmt.Fprintf assembly in codefix, codeimpl and internal/conform into embedded Markdown template files under internal/engine/prompts/, rendered through a single text/template-based Loader with typed view structs, golden-file tests, and run-time prompt auditing that writes what each phase was told to the state directory.

glossary.Loader: The prompt.Loader type in internal/engine/prompt that parses every embedded template at construction, validates headers, and renders templates against typed view structs.
glossary.document header: A YAML front-matter block at the top of every template file carrying name, kind, view, stable and max_bytes metadata.
glossary.golden file: A checked-in .golden.md file under internal/engine/testdata/prompts/ that records the expected rendering of a template against a fixture view; regenerated with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1.
glossary.partial: A template file under prompts/partials/ that is composed into other templates via {{template}} and is shared across tools.
glossary.prompt auditing: The run-time mechanism that writes the system prompt, user message and tool descriptions each phase sent to <state>/prompts/<tool>-<started_at>-<session_id>/.
glossary.view struct: One of BriefView, PhaseView or AttemptView — typed Go structs that carry the facts a template renders from, with no computation in the template itself.

requirements.title: Template tree and embedded document structure
requirements.rationale: Every model-facing string must live as a .md file under internal/engine/prompts/ so that prompt changes are Markdown diffs in review.

criteria.action: embed all .md files under internal/engine/prompts/ into the binary via a //go:embed prompts/**/*.md directive on an embed.FS variable, with subdirectories fix/, impl/, review/, brief/, partials/, tools/, refusals/ and rejections/

provide one template file per migrated prompt constant and builder function: fix/analyse.system.md, fix/analyse.md, fix/implement.system.md, fix/implement.md, impl/survey.system.md, impl/survey.md, impl/task.system.md, impl/task.md, impl/repair.system.md, impl/repair.md, impl/resolve.system.md, impl/resolve.md, review/review.system.md, review/review.md, brief/fix.md and brief/impl.md

provide shared partial templates under prompts/partials/ for report.md, baseline.md, gate.md, language.md, repomap.md, instructions.md, steering.md, criteria.md, definition_of_done.md, survey.md, landed_tasks.md, previous_attempt.md, scope.md, external_apis.md, date.md, context.md, read_roots.md and scratch.md

provide tool description templates under prompts/tools/ for execute.md, write_file.md and edit_file.md, and refusal templates under prompts/refusals/ for programs_not_allowed.md, suite.md, git_mutating.md and path_outside.md, and rejection templates under prompts/rejections/ for missing_verdicts.md and weak_evidence.md

requirements.title: Document headers and metadata validation
requirements.rationale: Front-matter metadata makes each template self-describing and enables automated validation of kind, view type and size constraints.

criteria.action: open with a YAML front-matter block delimited by --- lines containing the fields name (string), kind (one of system, message, brief, partial, tool, refusal, rejection), view (the Go struct name it renders from), stable (boolean) and max_bytes (positive integer)

criteria.condition: the Loader parses a template whose YAML header is missing any of the five required fields or whose kind is not in the allowed set
criteria.action: panic with a message naming the template and the invalid field
expose a Header(name string) Header method that returns the parsed front-matter of the named template

requirements.title: Loader construction, rendering and hashing
requirements.rationale: A single Loader type centralises template parsing, rendering with missingkey=error, and content hashing for the prompt_templates map.

criteria.condition: NewLoader() is called
criteria.action: parse every embedded template with text/template using Option("missingkey", "error"), register the function map (fence, code, join, count, lines, ref, ids, title, trimSpace, firstNonEmpty), validate every header, and return a *Loader; panic if any template is missing or malformed

criteria.condition: Render(name, view) is called with a valid template name and a view struct
criteria.action: execute the named template against the view and return the rendered string

criteria.condition: Render is called with a view that is missing a field the template references
criteria.action: return an error describing the missing field
criteria.contract: the returned error is non-nil and names the missing key

criteria.condition: Hash(name) is called
criteria.action: return the SHA-256 hex digest of the named template's embedded source (before rendering)

criteria.condition: Names() is called
criteria.action: return every template name in sorted order

criteria.condition: Hash is called with a name that does not exist in the embedded tree
criteria.action: panic with a message naming the unknown template

requirements.title: Typed view structs
requirements.rationale: Three view types separate run-constant, phase-varying and attempt-varying data so templates read fields and loop over lists without computing.

criteria.action: define BriefView with fields Root, Language, RepoMap, Instructions, Steering, VerifyCommands, BaselineResults, Context, Report and Spec, where Report and Spec are typed sub-structs

define PhaseView embedding BriefView and adding fields Branch, Date, Diagnosis, Criteria, Task, BaselineVerdicts, LandedTasks, MapDelta, Allowlist, ScratchPath, Survey, Scope, ExternalAPIs, Suite, TargetedRun, ReadRoots, AttemptNumber, TotalAttempts and PreviousAttempt
define AttemptView embedding PhaseView and adding fields PreviousFailure, RevertedDeclarations and AttemptIndex (1-based)
for any template, reference only fields defined on the view type named in its header; no template computes derived values — counts, joins and formatting use the registered function map

requirements.title: Template-injection safety
requirements.rationale: Untrusted text (reports, project instructions, steering) must pass through templates verbatim; text/template must not re-parse data values as template actions.

criteria.action: for any view whose string field contains text/template syntax such as {{.Secret}} or {{template "x"}}, render that text verbatim in the output without interpreting it as a template action
wrap untrusted text in --- BEGIN {LABEL} --- and --- END {LABEL} --- markers without interpreting or escaping the text content

requirements.title: Migration of existing prompts and removal of originals
requirements.rationale: After migration, the original Go constants and builder functions are removed; codefix, codeimpl and internal/conform import the Loader.

criteria.condition: codefix, codeimpl or internal/conform builds a phase
criteria.action: call loader.Render(name, view) to produce the system prompt and user message instead of referencing a Go constant or calling a builder function

criteria.condition: the migration is complete
criteria.action: contain no Go string constant or builder function in codefix/prompts.go, codeimpl/prompts.go or internal/conform/prompt.go that was a model-facing prompt; the original analysisSystemPrompt, implementSystemPrompt, surveySystemPrompt, repairSystemPrompt, resolveSystemPrompt, ReviewSystemPrompt constants and all prompt builder functions (analysisPrompt, implementPrompt, surveyPrompt, taskPrompt, repairPrompt, resolvePrompt, ReviewPrompt, reportBlock, baselineBlock, criteriaBlock, contextBlock, instructionsBlock, gateBlock, repoMapBlock, surveyBlock, previousAttemptBlock, externalAPIsBlock, languageBlock) are removed
produce output textually equivalent (modulo whitespace normalization) to the output the removed Go constant or builder function would have produced given the same inputs

criteria.condition: internal/agentrun/policy.go builds tool descriptions
criteria.action: render tool descriptions from tools/execute.md, tools/write_file.md and tools/edit_file.md templates via the Loader instead of using describeForPhase, noteScratch and noteReadRoots string concatenation

criteria.condition: internal/agentrun/guard.go produces a refusal message for a disallowed program, suite run, git-mutating command or path-outside-workspace
criteria.action: render the refusal from the corresponding refusals/*.md template via the Loader instead of building the message inline

criteria.condition: a submit tool handler in codefix or codeimpl rejects a submission with multi-sentence guidance (missing_verdicts, weak_evidence)
criteria.action: render the rejection from the corresponding rejections/*.md template via the Loader; short mechanical rejections (e.g. 'title is empty') remain inline
export a single projectInstructions function that replaces the identical copies in codefix/prompts.go and codeimpl/prompts.go, with the maxInstructionBytes constant (24 KiB) co-located

requirements.title: No-prose-in-Go enforcement test
requirements.rationale: A test is the acceptance gate for goal 1: no model-facing prose longer than one sentence remains in Go source.

criteria.action: walk every non-test .go file under internal/engine, codefix, codeimpl and internal/conform and fail on any string literal longer than 120 bytes that contains model-facing keywords ('You are a', 'Method:', 'Call this once', 'submit_', 'is refused', 'not allowed'), with exceptions for import paths, test fixtures and template files

requirements.title: Golden-file tests
requirements.rationale: Golden files make prompt changes visible as Markdown diffs in review and validate headers, stability and size constraints.

criteria.condition: TestGoldenPrompts runs
criteria.action: load every template via NewLoader(), render each against a fixture view, and compare the output to internal/engine/testdata/prompts/<name>.golden.md; fail on any mismatch

criteria.condition: the environment variable UPDATE_GOLDEN is set to 1
criteria.action: write the rendered output as the new golden file instead of failing on a mismatch

criteria.condition: a template has stable: true in its header
criteria.action: render the template twice with the same view and assert byte-identity of the two outputs

criteria.condition: a template is rendered
criteria.action: assert the rendered byte count does not exceed the max_bytes value from the template's header

criteria.condition: a template references another via {{template "partials/..."}}
criteria.action: assert the referenced partial exists in the embedded tree

requirements.title: Run-time prompt auditing
requirements.rationale: Writing what each phase was told to the state directory creates an audit trail paired to the report and events files by session_id.

criteria.condition: a phase is about to run
criteria.action: write the system prompt, user message and tool descriptions to <state>/prompts/<tool>-<started_at>-<session_id>/<phase>[.task-N][.attempt-N].<role>.md where role is system, user or tools, with directory mode 0755 and file mode 0644

criteria.condition: the prompts directory cannot be created or a prompt file cannot be written
criteria.action: record a low-severity prompts_not_written warning and continue the run without stopping
criteria.contract: the run completes; a Warning with code prompts_not_written and severity low is present in the envelope

criteria.condition: --dry-run is active
criteria.action: write prompt audit files to the state directory (they are local state, not side effects)

criteria.condition: the full report is built
criteria.action: include a prompt_templates field in the result: a map[string]string of document name to SHA-256 hex digest of the embedded source, present in the full detail view only

requirements.title: Additive envelope and artifact changes
requirements.rationale: New fields and constants are additive; no existing flag, exit code, envelope field or schema version changes.

criteria.action: define ArtifactPromptsDir ArtifactKind = "prompts_dir" in the artifact kind set with a Path field pointing to the prompts directory
define WarnPromptsNotWritten WarnCode = "prompts_not_written" in the warning code set
keep SchemaVersion at its current major value; the prompt_templates and prompts_dir additions do not change any existing field, flag, exit code or schema version

execution_paths.title: A fix run renders prompts from templates, writes audit files and produces a report with prompt_templates

steps.action: runs af-fix with a bug report input and a state directory
calls NewLoader() which parses and validates all embedded templates
builds a BriefView from the run's options and a PhaseView for the analysis phase
calls loader.Render("fix/analyse.system.md", view) and loader.Render("fix/analyse.md", view) to produce the system prompt and user message
writes the system prompt, user message and tool descriptions to <state>/prompts/<tool>-<started_at>-<session_id>/analyse.system.md, analyse.user.md and analyse.tools.md
runs the analysis phase with the rendered prompts
builds a PhaseView for the implement phase and renders fix/implement.system.md and fix/implement.md
writes the implement phase prompts to the same prompts directory
includes prompt_templates map (document name → SHA-256) and an ArtifactPromptsDir artifact in the full report

execution_paths.title: An impl run renders task and repair prompts from templates with attempt views

steps.action: runs af-impl with a spec input
calls NewLoader() and builds a BriefView and PhaseView for the survey phase
renders impl/survey.system.md and impl/survey.md via the Loader
builds a PhaseView for a task phase and renders impl/task.system.md and impl/task.md, composing partials (criteria, language, survey, external_apis)
on a repair attempt, builds an AttemptView and renders impl/repair.system.md and impl/repair.md with PreviousFailure
writes all phase prompts to <state>/prompts/<tool>-<started_at>-<session_id>/ with task and attempt suffixes
includes prompt_templates and prompts_dir artifact in the report

execution_paths.title: Golden test validates all templates against fixture views

steps.action: runs go test ./internal/engine/prompt/...
calls NewLoader(), iterates every template name, renders each against its fixture view, compares to the golden file, validates the header fields, checks max_bytes and stable rendering
walks .go files under codefix, codeimpl, internal/conform and internal/engine and fails on any string literal longer than 120 bytes containing model-facing keywords
reports pass or fail for each assertion

execution_paths.title: Guard refusal and tool description rendered from templates

steps.action: issues an execute tool call with a disallowed program
detects the disallowed program and calls loader.Render("refusals/programs_not_allowed.md", refusalView) to produce the refusal message
returns the rendered refusal to the model as a tool error result
issues a write_file tool call
has already rendered the write_file description from tools/write_file.md via the Loader, including scratch path and read roots from the PhaseView

symbols.name: Template.Execute
symbols.signature: func (t *Template) Execute(wr io.Writer, data any) error
